summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Definition of Done (DoD) feature for Sevora Engineering module. All 10 backend API tests passed. Frontend DoD tab, checklist items, progress tracking, and Kanban move validation all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: DoD feature is fully implemented with system defaults + project-specific configuration
DoD is configurable per task type (enabled for 'task' and 'bug' by default)
Kanban move to 'completed' is correctly blocked when DoD items are incomplete
skip_dod_check parameter allows admin override for moving tasks without DoD completion
DoD checklist items show completion timestamps and can be toggled individually

get_dod_config.details: Returns DoD configuration with system defaults or project-specific items

create_dod_config.details: Creates/updates DoD configuration for a project with custom items and issue types

update_dod_config.details: Updates DoD config items, enabled_for_issue_types, and is_enabled flag

get_task_dod_status.details: Returns DoD checklist status with items, completion percentage, and can_move_to_done flag

update_dod_item.details: Toggles DoD item completion status with timestamp tracking

initialize_task_dod.details: Initializes DoD checklist for a task based on project config

kanban_move_blocked.details: Correctly blocks move to 'completed' when DoD items are incomplete with DOD_INCOMPLETE error

kanban_move_allowed.details: Allows move to 'completed' when all required DoD items are done

kanban_skip_dod_check.details: Allows admin override to skip DoD validation

dod_issue_type_filtering.details: DoD is correctly applied based on enabled_for_issue_types configuration

frontend_dod_tab.details: DoD tab visible in task modal with checkmark indicator for completion status

frontend_dod_checklist.details: Shows required and optional items with completion status, timestamps, and progress bar

frontend_dod_messages.details: Shows 'Cannot move to Done' warning when incomplete, 'Ready to be marked as Done' when complete

seed_data_creation: Used existing project 4ce2e52d-d104-4f81-821c-b4ebdf132271 (Sevora Social Media Audit) and task 622fa624-7755-42c1-8d50-444c979cbe7c for testing
